_comment: Where the links that carry weight are supposed to point. Check A16 fails when
one of these changes, because nothing can infer that 'Read Unmissables' belongs
on Substack rather than anywhere else.
Only anchors go here — the destinations that would cost something if they broke.
Press and article links are not pinned; they change as coverage accumulates and
are covered by A15, which just checks they still return 200.
DRAFT, Sept 9 2026. Seeded from the current site. Confirm each one is right.
'label' is the text or context the link appears under; 'url' is what it must be.
